t.src_stm_id IN ( 53, 54 )

where
t.src_stm_id= '60' and t.ORIG_SRC_STM_CODE like 'MM%' and t.SRC_CRT_USRNM = 'BPMWRAPB';

left join ccal_repl_owner.txn_rltnp tr ON t.txn_id = tr.src_txn_id
and tr.actv_f = 'Y'
left join ccal_repl_owner.txn t2 ON tr.trgt_txn_id = t2.txn_id
SRC_PCS_TP_ID: ccal_repl_owner.txn t
left join transactions_owner.src_pcs_tp_dim sptd ON t.src_pcs_tp_id = sptd.src_pcs_tp_id
SRC_TXN_CODE: .
DB_CARD_TXN_DT: For TXN.SRC_STM_ID = 60 (ACTDETTD), use ORIG_TD.
Suppress from Original Trade Date for ACTDETTD source
SDIRA_TXN_YR: For TXN.SRC_STM_ID = 60 (ACTDETTD), use TRADE_NUMBER.
Parse to extract SDIRA Transaction Year (last two digits) and add century part.
For example, from "02726" value it will be "027" for SDIRA Transaction Type, while 26 stands for 2026 year.

rules.transformation_sql:
AGRT_ORIG_FEES: ccal_repl_owner.txn t
join ccal_repl_owner.apa ap ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id
LEFT join ccal_repl_owner.fip f ON f.apa_id = ap.apa_id
AGRT_STMT_FEES: ccal_repl_owner.txn t
join ccal_repl_owner.apa ap ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id
LEFT join ccal_repl_owner.fip f ON f.apa_id = ap.apa_id
ACT_CMSN_AMT: If TXN.SRC_STM_ID in (25, 94) --STSR or STSR2
and TXN.TXN_TP_ID not in (14, 1856) -- not Fund Trades
and FIP.FIP_TP_ID in (123, 160) --FIPCOM01, FIPCOM91
Then move STM_BASE_CCY_AMT
TRD_PCS_FEE_AMT: If TXN.SRC_STM_ID in (25, 94) --STSR or STSR2
and FIP.FIP_TP_ID = 125 (FIPFEE01, Processing (handling) Fee)
Then move STM_BASE_CCY_AMT
SEC_FEE_AMT: If TXN.SRC_STM_ID in (25, 94) --STSR or STSR2
and FIP.FIP_TP_ID = 126 (FIPTAX03, SEC Fee)
Then move STM_BASE_CCY_AMT
ACR_INT_AMT: If TXN.SRC_STM_ID in (25, 94) --STSR or STSR2
and FIP.FIP_TP_ID = 124 (FIPINT01, Accrued Interest)
Then move STM_BASE_CCY_AMT
CNCSN_AMT: If TXN.SRC_STM_ID in (25, 94) --STSR or STSR2
and TXN.TXN_TP_ID in (14, 1856) -- Fund Trades
and FIP.FIP_TP_ID in (123, 160) --FIPCOM01, FIPCOM91
Then move STM_BASE_CCY_AMT
CDSC_AMT: If TXN.SRC_STM_ID in (25, 94) --STSR or STSR2
and TXN.TXN_TP_ID in (14, 1856) -- Fund Trades
and TXN.BUY_SELL_IND = 'Sell'
and FIP.FIP_TP_ID = 132 (FIPFEE02, Miscellaneous Fee(s))
Then
for TXN.SRC_STM_ID = 94 move STM_BASE_CCY_AMT
for TXN.SRC_STM_ID = 25 move OTHR_FEE
OTHR_FEE_AMT: If TXN.SRC_STM_ID in (25, 94) --STSR or STSR2
and FIP.FIP_TP_ID = 132 (FIPFEE02, Miscellaneous Fee(s))
Then
for TXN.SRC_STM_ID = 94 move STM_BASE_CCY_AMT
for TXN.SRC_STM_ID = 25 move OTHR_FEE

If there is a record in CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_RLTNP table with TXN.TXN_ID = TXN_RLTNP.TRGT_TXN_ID
and TXN_RLTNP_TP_ID = 69 (Cancel)
and TXN_RLTNP.TRGT_TXN_ID <> TXN_RLTNP.SRC_TXN_ID
then set to 'Y' for both TRGT_TXN_ID and SRC_TXN_ID.

The check should be performed each time when a new record is written into CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_RLTNP with TXN_RLTNP_TP_ID = 69 and update the flag for both TRGT_TXN_ID and SRC_TXN_ID, if TXN_RLTNP.TRGT_TXN_ID <> TXN_RLTNP.SRC_TXN_ID.

Note: TXN_RLTNP.TRGT_TXN_ID <> TXN_RLTNP.SRC_TXN_ID is needed because it is possible that cancellation trade points to itself when the original trade that is being cancelled is not found. In this case Cancelled Flag should not be set to 'Y'

Fetch FA_NUMBER_V.FA_NUMBER_TYPE_CODE As OWN_FA_NUM_TP_CD

LEFT Join with CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN TXN With CCSI_OWNER.AR_GRP_SUBDIM AR_GRP_SUBDIM ON TXN.AR_ID = AR_GRP_SUBDIM.AR_ID
And TXN.TD >= AR_GRP_SUBDIM.EFF_DT
And TXN.TD < AR_GRP_SUBDIM.END_DT

And TXN.TD >= FA_NUMBER_V.EFFECTIVE_DATE
And TXN.TD < FA_NUMBER_V.END_DATE

And TXN.TD < AR_GRP_SUBDIM.END_DT

ccal_repl_owner.txn t

join ccal_repl_owner.AR_DIM BKR_AR_DIM ON T.AR_ID = BKR_AR_DIM.AR_ID
and TD >= BKR_AR_DIM.EFF_DT (+) 
and TD < BKR_AR_DIM.END_DT (+))

Else join ccsi_owner.AR_GRP_SUBDIM asd ON asd.AR_ID = t.AR_ID
and t.td >= asd.EFF_DT
and t.td < asd.END_DT
and populate with asd.LINKED_BKR_AR_ID

analysis_rows.transformation:
If there is a record in CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_RLTNP table with TXN.TXN_ID = TXN_RLTNP.TRGT_TXN_ID
and TXN_RLTNP_TP_ID = 69 (Cancel)
and TXN_RLTNP.TRGT_TXN_ID <> TXN_RLTNP.SRC_TXN_ID
then set to 'Y' for both TRGT_TXN_ID and SRC_TXN_ID.

The check should be performed each time when a new record is written into CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_RLTNP with TXN_RLTNP_TP_ID = 69 and update the flag for both TRGT_TXN_ID and SRC_TXN_ID, if TXN_RLTNP.TRGT_TXN_ID <> TXN_RLTNP.SRC_TXN_ID.

Note: TXN_RLTNP.TRGT_TXN_ID <> TXN_RLTNP.SRC_TXN_ID is needed because it is possible that cancellation trade points to itself when the original trade that is being cancelled is not found. In this case Cancelled Flag should not be set to 'Y'
analysis_rows.notes:
[05/28/25]: Product Backlog Item 2030710: Populate new columns for trade and fee attributes for Activity

NOTE: This logic is different from TDS/DWH cancelled_flag. Lighthouse will have the flag set only for [cancellation trade + cancelled trade] pair, while TDS/DWH flag is also set for reversals and orphan cancels that don't point to initial trades

    ON T.EXG_DIM_ID = CTL.EXG_DIM_ID
WHERE NVL(TO_CHAR(T.BUY_SELL_IND), '-999') <> NVL(TO_CHAR(CTL.BUY_SELL_IND), '-999')

SELECT /*+ PARALLEL(32) */ COUNT(*) AS mismatch_count
FROM IKOROSTELEV.AVY_FACT_SIDE T
JOIN IKOROSTELEV.AVY_FACT_SIDE CTL
    ON T.EXG_DIM_ID = CTL.EXG_DIM_ID
WHERE NVL(TO_CHAR(T.OWN_FA_ENT_SUBS), '-999') <> NVL(TO_CHAR(CTL.OWN_FA_ENT_SUBS), '-999')

analysis_rows.transformation:
Use APACSH logic from 'ETL Notes' tab.

For a Transaction, If 2 APACSH records exists
     If (one record is 'APACSH04' & other is 'APACSH11') 
          then skip 'APACSH04' record and load 'APACSH11' but use the values to
          populate sales charge attributes from 'APACSH04' for 5 attributes (Sales Charge Rate Multiplier Number, Sales Charge Rate, Sales Charge Rate Type Code, Sales Charge Rate Type Id, Sales Charge Rate Type Name)
     else exception entire transaction

ccal_repl_owner.txn t
join ccal_repl_owner.apa ap ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id
left join ccal_repl_owner.cl_val cv ON AP.APA_TP_ID = cv.CL_VAL_ID AND
CASE    WHEN AP.SALE_CHRG_RATE_TP_ID = 2507 
            THEN AP.SALE_CHRG_RATE
analysis_rows.notes:
TXN.TXN_ID = APA.EXEC_ID
SALE_CHRG_RATE where SALE_CHRG_RATE_TP_ID = 2507 ELSE NULL

Ref: Bug 2198208: Sales Charges are not populated for MFL4 trades due to APACSH04 being dropped

analysis_rows.transformation:
If there is a record in CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_RLTNP table with TXN.TXN_ID = TXN_RLTNP.TRGT_TXN_ID
and TXN_RLTNP_TP_ID = 69 (Cancel)
and TXN_RLTNP.TRGT_TXN_ID <> TXN_RLTNP.SRC_TXN_ID
then set to 'Y' for both TRGT_TXN_ID and SRC_TXN_ID.

The check should be performed each time when a new record is written into CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_RLTNP with TXN_RLTNP_TP_ID = 69 and update the flag for both TRGT_TXN_ID and SRC_TXN_ID, if TXN_RLTNP.TRGT_TXN_ID <> TXN_RLTNP.SRC_TXN_ID.

Note: TXN_RLTNP.TRGT_TXN_ID <> TXN_RLTNP.SRC_TXN_ID is needed because it is possible that cancellation trade points to itself when the original trade that is being cancelled is not found. In this case Cancelled Flag should not be set to 'Y'
analysis_rows.notes:
[05/28/25]: Product Backlog Item 2030710: Populate new columns for trade and fee attributes for Activity

NOTE: This logic is different from TDS/DWH cancelled_flag. Lighthouse will have the flag set only for [cancellation trade + cancelled trade] pair, while TDS/DWH flag is also set for reversals and orphan cancels that don't point to initial trades
